
# Load dataset

```{r,warning=FALSE}

```

Create dftrial

```{r}
# divide treated and untreated
trt=df %>% 
  filter(trt==1) %>% 
  select(id,event,timedays,duration,timedaystrt,calendar)
```

# Idea

Double all patients

```{r}
counter=rbind(trt,trt) %>% 
  arrange(id) %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(timec=ifelse(row_number()==1,timedaystrt,timedays-duration),
         trtc=ifelse(row_number()==1,1,0),
         eventc=ifelse(timec>=730,0,1),
         timec=ifelse(timec>=730,730,timec)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(id,eventc,trtc,timec,calendar)
```

Model

```{r}
model=coxph(Surv(timec,eventc)~trtc+calendar,counter)
summary(model)
```

Predict probabilities at two years in the trial

## survfit

```{r,eval=F}
# treated and untreated dataset
newdata0 = trt %>% mutate(trtc=0, calendar = calendar)
newdata1 = trt %>% mutate(trtc=1, calendar = calendar)
# predict for both
fit0=survfit(model,newdata=newdata0)
fit1=survfit(model,newdata=newdata1)
# get summary for both dataset at two years
s0=summary(fit0,times=730)
s1=summary(fit1,times=730)
# get mean survival time for treated and untreated
mean_surv0=mean(s0$surv)   
mean_surv1=mean(s1$surv)  
# get risks
risk0=1-mean_surv0
risk1=1-mean_surv1
# calculate risk ratio
risk_ratio=risk1/risk0
```

## number by hands

```{r}
# treated and untreated dataset
newdata0=trt %>% mutate(trtc=0,calendar=calendar)
newdata1=trt %>% mutate(trtc=1,calendar=calendar)
# get baseline cumulative hazard once
bh=basehaz(model,centered=TRUE)
H0=approx(bh$time,bh$hazard,xout=730,method="constant",rule=2)$y
S0=exp(-H0)
# linear predictors
lp0=predict(model,newdata=newdata0,type="lp")
lp1=predict(model,newdata=newdata1,type="lp")
# individual survival probabilities at t=730
surv0 = S0 ^ exp(lp0)
surv1 = S0 ^ exp(lp1)
# mean probability
mean_surv0 = mean(surv0)
mean_surv1 = mean(surv1)
# get risk 
risk0 = 1 - mean_surv0
risk1 = 1 - mean_surv1
# risk ratio
risk_ratio = risk1 / risk0
```
